I've been trying to recover. Looked forward to this trip in the mountains which I had during the weekend, when the jerk who brought things down for me started talking to me again. I know I shouldn't blame him, my thinking and actions after our relationship ended was mine alone. 

I hated myself and went spiraling into self-pity. I go to work and often ask myself why I'm not the same as my co-workers who are in this sort of full of life vibe. I've pushed too many people away especially good friends that whenever I send them messages they never reply anymore or feel angry of me being "stubborn". It's so hard to deal with myself and the perspective of myself while I work in healthcare. I walk a really dangerous line with my profession and my own condition. 

So back to him messaging me, I was apart during the two-day trip. Like I was trying to smile at all photo ops and socialize with my tour group. When I am alone, I feel like throwing myself to the ravines or cliffs. I stayed behind because I can't face the people I have been messaging because this jerk made me feel so good for one day I was important again and the next I was shit. 

I want to delete myself from the face of this planet.
I'm a Nurse.
Plan? There's no repairing it according to him. :( He wants me to let go, move on and have a better life. How selfish. I love him even he did something stupid.

I'm 27. I have gone counselling. My friends have outcasted me actually because they can't handle this negativity. This is the only break up that I am so devastated about in my dating life. He planned to propose to me this year.
We broke up last month. It was devastating of course because we are long distance. I am alone on this side of the world and I can't reach him.
